Extracts heading hierarchy (h1-h6) from HTML page

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using Crawlberg;

var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(null);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.ScrapeAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.StatusCode);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Headings![0].Level);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Headings![0].Text);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Headings!.Count);
```
